data.summary: Dynamic and impact-driven Lead Business Analyst/Product Owner with 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, driving platform modernization, and delivering enterprise-grade SaaS and automated solutions. Proven track record of bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution across Banking & Financial Services (Citi, Payments) and Enterprise Software (ServiceNow, GCP). Adept at managing end-to-end product lifecycles, owning product backlogs, automating high-risk workflows, and orchestrating Agile/Scrum delivery to drive 80%+ efficiency gains and 100% client satisfaction. Certified IIBA AAC professional skilled in GenAI integration, process re-engineering, and strategic stakeholder management.

raw_sections.experience:
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Virtusa Consulting Pvt. Ltd. | Pune, Maharashtra
Nov 2024 – Present
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner (Banking Domain – Citi Bank)

Led business analysis via MS Visio to map cross-border payment flows and design Target Operating Models (TOM) for SEPA Instant Payments, integrating primary clearing networks (Target2, STEP2, FedNow, Bacs, FPS).
Orchestrated data structures migration from legacy SWIFT MT formats to modern ISO 20022 MX XML schemas, authoring comprehensive schema workbooks in Excel to prevent data truncation.
Configured conditional, intelligent routing logic to dynamically direct high-volume liquidity flows, utilizing SQL queries to analyze payload metadata discrepancies and slash domestic failure rates by 30%.
Automated end-to-end transactional reporting pipelines for international remittances (Project Synergy), capturing compliance requirements for Sight/Deferred Letters of Credit (LC) for Bangladesh and ECB/EBA Eurozone regulations. ● Remediated End-User Computing (EUC) Risks: Identified critical operational vulnerabilities caused by high-risk manual spreadsheets. Replaced legacy EUCs with automated, controlled system modules. Installed data validation rules and audit trails to protect data integrity and clear outstanding audit findings.
Analyzed system usage patterns with SQL/Excel Power Query and engineered executive Power BI dashboards to translate complex system architecture redundancies into technology rationalisation insights.
Owned the end-to-end product backlog in Jira, authoring detailed User Stories with testable BDD Acceptance Criteria, while leveraging Jira velocity charts and Confluence documentation to optimize sprint predictability.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Agile Governance by facilitating core Agile ceremonies—including Sprint Planning,
Backlog Refinement, and Daily Standups.
Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Pune, Maharashtra
Jul 2021 – Nov 2024
Senior Business Analyst (Techno-Functional)
Successfully managed functional delivery across 7+ enterprise clients and 17+ concurrent projects, achieving a 100% client satisfaction rate through requirement gathering, gap analysis, and system architecture mapping.
Facilitated executive design workshops to elicit requirements; authored comprehensive BRDs, FRDs, configuration workbooks, and workflow diagrams (Visio) for custom enterprise applications.
Utilized GCP BigQuery, SQL, Teradata, Workato, and ServiceNow to analyze complex data sets, scope automated integration solutions, and execute end-to-end testing protocols.

Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) checkpoints, established feedback loops with client leads, and managed Change Requests (CRs) to ensure seamless feature enhancements without delivery delays.
Mentored junior analysts on functional design and domain capabilities; delivered training programs for client HR and Service Delivery teams to ensure Day-1 operational readiness.
Replicon Software India Pvt. Ltd. | Bangalore, Karnataka
Jun 2018 – Jul 2021
Associate Integration Consultant
Partnered with Product Management, Engineering, and Services teams to align software feature roadmaps with enterprise client network and workflow requirements.
Defined project scopes, established delivery schedules, and managed resource allocation for new software implementations while maintaining alignment with client business objectives.
Audited weekly production deployments, conducted live project monitoring, and performed QA reviews to eliminate operational bottlenecks and improve system stability.
Convergys India Pvt. Ltd. | Bangalore, Karnataka
Sep 2016 – Jun 2018
Technical Support Associate II
Managed technical troubleshooting for enterprise software and operating systems, resolving complex client inquiries while maintaining consistently high customer satisfaction scores.

Secondary School Education | Jun 1996 - Mar 2009 | St. Francis High School | Nashik, Maharashtra

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Dynamic and impact-driven Lead Business Analyst/Product Owner with 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, driving platform modernization, and delivering enterprise-grade SaaS and automated solutions. Proven track record of bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution across Banking & Financial Services (Citi, Payments) and Enterprise Software (ServiceNow, GCP). Adept at managing end-to-end product lifecycles, owning product backlogs, automating high-risk workflows, and orchestrating Agile/Scrum delivery to drive 80%+ efficiency gains and 100% client satisfaction. Certified IIBA AAC professional skilled in GenAI integration, process re-engineering, and strategic stakeholder management.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Product & Project Ownership: Product Backlog Ownership, User Story Mapping & Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Given-
When-Then), Strategic Product Roadmapping, Project Scoping & Lifecycle Management, Feature Prioritization (MoSCoW, RICE, Kano), Solution Architecture, Risk Mitigation & EUC Remediation.
Requirements & Systems Analysis: Functional & Technical Specifications (BRD, FRD, FSD), As-Is / To-Be Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone), Data Modeling, System Architecture Diagrams, API Scoping & Integration Mapping.
Domain & Business Strategy: Banking & Financial Services (Payments & Receivables), Regulatory & Compliance
Automation, HRIS/HCM Systems, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR), ROI & Feasibility Assessment.
Agile & Stakeholder Management: Scrum & Kanban Frameworks, Cross-functional Team Leadership, Executive Stakeholder Engagement & Design Workshops, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Strategy & Governance, Change Management (CRs), Change Impact Assessment.
Technical Tools & Analytics: SQL, GCP BigQuery, Teradata, Postman (API Testing), Visio, Jira & Confluence, Workato, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday, Zendesk, Power BI, GenAI Implementation.
